title: Resolution urging Albany to fund child care worker pay raises
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.5533/A.492A, creating a Child Care Workforce Pay Equity Fund. The bill would appropriate $1.2 billion to provide an estimated flat wage subsidy of $12,500 to child care staff and providers across the state. Supporters say the fund would address low wages that drive high turnover among early childhood educators, whose median annual wage in New York State is about $33,000.
